Order 
This first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No. 07/2023 dated 07.01.2023 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Bhopal (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 419, 420, 406, 467,
468, 471 and 120-B of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 09.02.2023.
2.

As per the prosecution story, a complaint was lodged on 07.01.2023 by Adil Javed and Arif Qureshi that the master mind Ajeemuddin lured them that he could get them three shops allotted behind the Mrignanyani Emporium.
On this assurance, both the complainants paid him around Rs.79 lakhs in cash, however, the shops were not allotted.

It was stated that Ajeemuddin to take them into confidence, got some loan agreement executed with one Ram Bharose, Omprakash and the present applicant and thereafter gave them some allotment letters, which were ultimately found to be forged as the complainants came to know that the said shops were allotted to some other Naeem Mohammad vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164636376/
1 persons.
3.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the only allegation against the present applicant is that he executed the loan agreement on 04.08.2021 with the complainants, there is no allegation that any amount was handed over to him.
It is further pointed out that in the loan agreement dated 04.08.2021, the sign of present applicant is missing.
4. This fact has not been disputed by the learned counsel for the respondent/State.
5. From the statement of the complainants, it is obvious that there is no allegation that any amount was paid to the present applicant.
The only allegation against present applicant is that he got filled some allotment application and prepared forged allotment letter.
Co-accused Chand Khan has already been released on bail.
The case of present applicant is identical to the case of co-accused.
6. Considering the aforesaid, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant - Naeem Mohammad be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
